summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Founder Group Limited, a foreign private issuer, disclosing approval of director compensation arrangements effective June 11, 2026. The CEO receives monthly share-based compensation of US$17,500; another director receives US$4,000 cash plus US$7,500 in shares; three independent directors receive monthly cash amounts of US$5,000, US$2,500, and US$4,000, respectively. Share-based compensation is settled via issuance of Class B ordinary shares calculated using the closing price of Class A shares. This is routine executive compensation disclosure, not a special situation.
